content.text:
Findings below.

## 1. What creates a FreeMinecraftServer, and what UI calls it

**Server action:** `createFreeMinecraftServer` — `/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/actions-free-minecraft.ts:78` (row created at `:155-165`).

**The only UI that calls it:** `FreeMinecraftCreateForm` — `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/customer/FreeMinecraftPanel.tsx:10` (bound via `useActionState` at `:19`). This is the single creation component in the whole app.

Rendering chain (one shared server component, two routes):
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/customer/freemc/FreeMinecraftTabContent.tsx:14` — decides create-form vs. dashboard; renders `FreeMinecraftCreateForm` at `:45`, `FreeMcDashboard` at `:33`.
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/dashboard/free-minecraft/page.tsx:22`
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/dashboard/games/page.tsx:70` (only when `?tab=free`)

Pending-state overlay: `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/customer/FreeMinecraftLoader.tsx:42`, used at `FreeMinecraftPanel.tsx:25` (create can block up to ~180s).

## 2. Route of the creation UI

**Two routes, same component:**
- `/dashboard/free-minecraft` — `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/dashboard/free-minecraft/page.tsx:12` (kept alive specifically for marketing/directory deep links, per its comment at `:7-11`)
- `/dashboard/games?tab=free` — `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/dashboard/games/page.tsx:30, 69` (the canonical in-app location now; the sidebar entry moved here)

The marketing page `/free-minecraft` (`/opt/nxeon-v2/app/(marketing)/free-minecraft/page.tsx`) does **not** contain a create form — it only CTAs into `/dashboard/free-minecraft`.

## 3. Every in-app entry point

In-dashboard (signed-in):
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/dashboard/games/page.tsx:55` — the "Free Minecraft" tab link (`/dashboard/games?tab=free`) with the green FREE pill. **This is the only in-app link that reaches the creation UI for a user who has no server yet.**
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/dashboard/layout.tsx:45` — sidebar "Game Servers" → `/dashboard/games`, `tag: "FREE"` (lands on My Servers tab, not the free tab)
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/nx/nav.ts:26` — portal shell nav "Game servers" → `/dashboard/games`, `badge: "FREE"` (consumed by `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/nx/Shell.tsx:25`); same indirection
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/nx/services.ts:285` — services list row href `/dashboard/free-minecraft`, but only emitted `if (freeMc)` (`:279`), i.e. only for users who **already** have one

Marketing (reachable while signed in):
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/marketing/freetiertemplate/data.ts:16` — `CLAIM_HREF = "/dashboard/free-minecraft"`, used at `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/marketing/freetiertemplate/FreeTierTemplate.tsx:337, 449, 533` (the three CTAs on `/free-minecraft` and `/preview/free-tier`)
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/(marketing)/servers/page.tsx:95, 111, 155` — → `/dashboard/free-minecraft`; `:89, 156` → `/free-minecraft`
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/(marketing)/servers/[subdomain]/page.tsx:180` — → `/dashboard/free-minecraft`
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx:57` — → `/free-minecraft`
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/llms.txt/route.ts:76`, `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/sitemap.ts:27` — → `/free-minecraft`

Two dead ends worth flagging:
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/app/(marketing)/game-servers/directory/page.tsx:174` — `href: "/free-minecraft-hosting"`. **That route does not exist** (no page under `app/`, no entry in `next.config.ts`'s `redirects()` at `:120-153`) — a 404 on the directory page's primary CTA.
- `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/nx/PromoCarousel.tsx:58-61` — the "Claim it" freemc promo slide on the dashboard home (`/opt/nxeon-v2/components/nx/DashboardView.tsx:415`) renders its CTA as a bare `<button>` with no href/onClick (`PromoCarousel.tsx:202-205`) — the promo is not clickable through to the create UI.

## 4. Gates and preconditions

All in `createFreeMinecraftServer`, in order:
1. **Feature flag** — `getSettingBool("free_minecraft_enabled", false)` at `actions-free-minecraft.ts:101` (DB setting, not an env var). Declared at `/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/actions-settings.ts:257`, toggled at `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/admin/settings/FreeMinecraftPanel.tsx:22`. UI mirrors it: `FreeMinecraftTabContent.tsx:16, 23-29` shows "Free servers aren't open yet" instead of the form.
2. **Auth** — `requireUser()` at `:79`.
3. **Email verified** — `assertEmailVerified(user)` at `:106`. Note this is itself gated by the `email_verification_enforced` setting and fails open by default (`/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/email-verification.ts:123-133, 160`), so in the current config it is effectively a no-op. No account-age check exists.
4. **Rate limit** — 5 creates/60s per user, `:111`.
5. **Subdomain format + reserved words** — `validateSubdomainFormat` at `:115`, rules at `/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/game-subdomain-rules.ts:14-15` (`^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{1,18}[a-z0-9])?$`, 3–20 chars, reserved set `www/api/admin/mc/play/test/server/router`).
6. **Subdomain uniqueness across free + paid namespaces** — `isSubdomainAvailable` at `:117`, `/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/game-subdomain.ts:16-30`.
7. **One-per-user** — explicit pre-check at `:119-120` returning `"You already have a free server. Delete it before creating another."`; backed by `FreeMinecraftServer.userId @unique` (`/opt/nxeon-v2/prisma/schema.prisma:2683`) and the `catch` at `:166-168` (which reports any create failure, including a userId collision, as "That name is taken" — slightly wrong message for the race case).
8. **Live host capacity** — `free_minecraft_max_concurrent` (default 8) compared against *actually running* containers via SSH, `:134-144`; refuses on check failure rather than overcommitting. A second, stricter CPU/RAM-headroom check lives inside `recreateGameTypeContainer` and its "at capacity" message is passed through verbatim (`:204-216`).

**If the user already has one:** the UI never shows the form — `FreeMinecraftTabContent.tsx:31-43` renders `FreeMcDashboard` instead. They must delete first via `deleteFreeMinecraftServer` (`actions-free-minecraft.ts:227`), wired at `/opt/nxeon-v2/components/customer/freemc/FreeMcDashboard.tsx:320, 353-356`.

## 5. Fields, and what happens after

**Fields** (`FreeMinecraftPanel.tsx`):
- `subdomain` — text input, `:29-38`, client-side `pattern`/`minLength`/`maxLength` mirroring `SUBDOMAIN_RE`; shown as `<name>.<free_minecraft_domain>` (default `play.nxeon.cloud`)
- `gameType` — hidden input + card picker, `:46-67`; keys from `FREEMC_GAME_TYPES` (`/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/free-minecraft-control.ts:581-616`: vanilla, skyblock, prison, towny, parkour, anarchy, lifesteal, missilewars, survivalgames)
- `gameMode` — hidden input + pills, `:73-88`; survival/hardcore/creative/peaceful (`free-minecraft-control.ts:628-646`)
- Legacy `preset` field is still accepted as a fallback (`actions-free-minecraft.ts:87-97`, `mapLegacyPresetKey` at `:55`)

**After submit** — the action is fully synchronous; **there is no worker job**:
- Row inserted with `status: "CREATING"`, `containerName = mc-free-<userId>`, plus `activeGameType`/`activeGameMode`/derived legacy `preset` (`:152-165`)
- SSH to the `freemc-host` Server row (`:64-71`), `mkdir /opt/freemc/servers/<row.id>`, then `recreateGameTypeContainer` (`/opt/nxeon-v2/lib/free-minecraft-control.ts:851`) does the `docker run` and waits for readiness (`:170-187`)
- On failure: best-effort `docker rm -f`, then the DB row is deleted, and a customer-safe error is returned (`:188-217`)
